persistent_tail.policy: preserve unless independently proven damaged; never include in an application rollback by default

r01d_recovery.use_condition: only when all current target-sector hashes exactly match the original R01d failed image

future_recovery_policy: acquire two identical fresh 1 MiB forced-loader dumps before writing
derive the changed 4 KiB sector set from the exact failed v15 image versus the exact official v15 package
require every current target-sector SHA-256 to match the failed image before erase
write only the official v15 versions of those target sectors
verify erase-to-FF, immediate readback SHA-256, and post-restore outside-sector invariance
do not repeat the historical 148-sector v012 emergency restore for a target-specific v15 failure
